jobs.title: Finance Data Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
Your team

La division Corporate Functions regroupe les activités non bancaires du Groupe et compte plus de 600 collaborateurs. Assurées par des spécialistes connaissant parfaitement l’ensemble des lignes de métier, les fonctions centrales se répartissent en divers départements: Communication, Compliance, Finances, Ressources humaines, Sécurité de l’information, Audit interne, Juridique, Corporate Office, Risques et Fiscalité.

Your role

• Assurer la stabilité, la qualité et la sécurité des données mises à disposition, en particulier pour la production des nombreux indicateurs liés à la comptabilité analytique et financière.
• Développer, tenir à jour et optimiser des pipelines de données robustes en intégrant des solutions innovantes d’automatisation.
• Contribuer à la revue et à l’évolution de l’architecture des systèmes et des flux de données.
• Concevoir et développer des solutions innovantes, incluant l’intégration de modèles d’IA pour la détection d’anomalies, la prévision ou l’optimisation, afin d’améliorer la qualité, la disponibilité et la traçabilité des données et des rapports produits.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes du département Finances, les lignes de métier et la division Pictet Tech afin de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre le meilleur environnement pour l’utilisation optimale des données pertinentes.
• Piloter et assurer le suivi de projets de déploiement et/ou de transformation de systèmes informatiques majeurs au niveau du Groupe et/ou des entités juridiques, en coordonnant les activités entre les fournisseurs, Pictet Tech et les lignes de métier.
• Accompagner et former les équipes Finances dans l’adoption des nouvelles fonctionnalités, en favorisant l’innovation et l’optimisation de leur efficacité opérationnelle.

Your profile

• Formation universitaire, idéalement en informatique, data science, ingénierie ou un domaine connexe.
• Expérience d’au minimum 7 ans à des fonctions similaires, avec un accent important sur la gestion des données et l’innovation technologique.
• Bonnes connaissances en architecture des systèmes et en structuration des données.
• Excellente connaissance de la gestion des bases de données Oracle et Snowflake (PLSQL et SQL).
• Expérience en développement applicatif (Apex, Python, Streamlit, JavaScript, Angular et React).
• Expérience des outils de business intelligence (Tableau, BusinessObjects et Sigma).
• Expérience dans l’intégration de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (Copilot, Anthropic, etc.) et la création des agents: un atout majeur.
• Bonne connaissance du monde bancaire et des produits financiers (y. c. des fonds): un avantage.
• Autonomie, flexibilité, discipline, aptitude à gérer les priorités et faculté à apprendre rapidement.
• Excellentes capacités de communication orale et écrite, en anglais et en français.
• Domicile en Suisse requis.

Note

Nous n'acceptons pas de CVs via agences.

Réf.: FDAS/CC/BS

jobs.title: Internship - Private Assets
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide,currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Luxembourg since 1989 where it employs over 600 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

You will join the PETAL - Private Assets team, the Pictet Luxembourg Private Assets operational servicing entity.

• Start date : September 2026

• Duration : 6 months full time or 12 months in apprenticeship

• Mandatory : A tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Perform daily checks to ensure that all transactions are recorded in due time.

• Understand the investment made by client (review of the prospectus).

• Analyze notices received from Private Equity, Real Estate and Private Debt funds to perform the booking accurately.

• Cash reconciliation.

• Assist the team with various tasks (draft annual accounts, reply to audit queries, prepare ad hoc reporting to clients,…

• Monitor team mailboxes and ensure continuity of operations.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• Pursuing a Master or University degree in Finance/Economics/Engineering

Specific knowledge:

• Prioritising and time management skills to address the volumes and urgent subjects

• Analytical mindset to investigate, analyse and understand our investments and counter parties communications

• Collaborative skills to navigate a multinational workplace

Language skills:

• Written and spoken fluency in French and English

Personal qualities:

• Adaptive and transversal knowledge capability to be able to communicate (in written and orally) with Petal teams

• Rigorous and attentive to detail.

• Team player who is approachable and flexible.

• Dynamic and possesses an enquiring mind.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

jobs.description:
Your team

The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation.

The Financial Institutions Management (FIM) team, part of the Finance Department, is the Group's centre of expertise for managing relationships with financial institutions. As a key member of this team, you will help maintain and enhance the Group's vital relationships with our financial counterparties.

Your role

We are seeking a proactive and analytical professional to take ownership of optimising data management, streamlining workflows, and driving process automation across the team's activities. You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation.

You will be responsible for the following tasks:

Process improvement and automation

• Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
• Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
• Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
• Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions.

Data Management and Quality

• Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
• Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
• Implement and monitor automated data quality controls, ensuring data reconciliation and consistency across systems.

Reporting and Monitoring

• Prepare impactful dashboards reports, and presentations for internal teams and senior management, using state-of-the-art data visualisation tools.
• Participate in projects that impact the team's activities, driving innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new data science methodologies.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or equivalent.
• 3 to 5 years of experience and keen interest in banking, or previous experience in the banking industry.
• Experience in KYC/AML would be a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and able to take initiative, structured, with strong attention to detail.
• Committed, results-driven and accountable.
• Strong team spirit with the ability to collaborate across teams and business lines.
• Keen interest in process improvement, automation and data visualisation, leveraging technology.
• Experience in SQL and Python.
• Experience with Business Intelligence Tools (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) and in Gen AI project implementation.
• Familiarity with data management concepts (data quality/governance).
• Fluent in French and English; other languages are a plus.
• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : D&PAFC/CC/AK

You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation. You will be responsible for the following tasks: Process improvement and automation
• Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
• Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
• Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
• Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions. Data Management and Quality
• Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
• Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
• Implement and monitor automated data quality controls, ensuring data reconciliation and consistency across systems. Reporting and Monitoring
• Prepare impactful dashboards reports, and presentations for internal teams and senior management, using state-of-the-art data visualisation tools.
• Participate in projects that impact the team's activities, driving innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new data science methodologies. Your profile
• Master’s degree or equivalent.
• 3 to 5 years of experience and keen interest in banking, or previous experience in the banking industry.
• Experience in KYC/AML would be a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and able to take initiative, structured, with strong attention to detail.
• Committed, results-driven and accountable.
• Strong team spirit with the ability to collaborate across teams and business lines.
• Keen interest in process improvement, automation and data visualisation, leveraging technology.
• Experience in SQL and Python.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

This function will join the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams (FA, TA and PETAL) and occasionally help the production teams during peak periods.

Your role

Mobile team

• Participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency.

• Identify areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework, based on your experience in other teams and departments.

The role of the function is to participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency.

Quality Control

• Contribute to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs developed with our BI platform (Tableau).

• Coordinate transversal reporting.

• Contribute to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery.

Your profile

Education:

• Master’s degree in Business administration or engineering (finance, IT, mathematics).

Requested experience:

• 1 to 3 years’ experience in project management and change management, Process / data modelling, Fund operations or banking sector.

Technical skills:

• Project Management skills.

• Data analysis and office tools skills (Excel, Tableau, PowerPoint, etc.).

Soft skills:

• Organisational skills.

• Diligent in achieving objectives.

• Strong analytical and synthesis skills.

• Effective communication abilities and good interpersonal skills.

• Commitment-oriented mindset and a team spirit.

Language skills:

• Fluent in French and English

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Reporting Analyst
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions,financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

The Investment Reporting team serves institutional clients and financial intermediaries through three core pillars: producing high‑quality client and marketing documents; promoting an exceptional client experience by providing customized and timely solutions; and innovating to continuously improve how documents are designed, produced and distributed.

Your role

Production of documents

• Deliver high‑quality investment reports, marketing materials and client presentations with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency and timeliness.

• Own end‑to‑end production topics: manage priorities with stakeholders,anticipate bottlenecks, and ensure reliable delivery during peak periods.

• Contribute to strengthening production robustness through ongoing process improvements.

• Play an integral role in the migration of existing reports to the Vermilion Reporting Suite (VRS) and the transition of our data to Snowflake.

Client Experience Enhancement

• Improve client satisfaction by raising quality standards and service responsiveness.

• Evolve reports, templates and content to enhance investment insights, increase clarity, storytelling and visual impact for our clients.

• Partner with Sales and Investment teams for client meetings/reviews and translate feedback into concrete improvements in reporting output and service practices.

Reporting Innovation

• Identify pragmatic opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring tasks to improve efficiency and quality at scale by using technology.

Your profile

We’re looking for a proactive, motivated and skilled individual who brings analytical thinking, technical skills to support modern reporting, a client mindset, and a collaborative approach. The ideal candidate will have:

• A university degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics , or a related field.

• A solid understanding of financial markets , with experience in investment reporting / client reporting or a similar environment with a strong focus on Fixed Income and Multi-Asset.

• Strong analytical problem-solving skills , high attention to detail , and a proven quality mindset.

• Comfortable working independently , taking ownership, and collaborating effectively across teams and locations.

• Ability to translate complex investment data into clear, visually compelling client-facing material.

• Advanced SQL, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Experience with VRS / Snowflake / Tableau is a strong asset.

• Strong interest in new technology and AI / GenAI, applied to automation, quality controls and innovation generation, Python highly valued.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead.

Your role

Key responsibilities

-Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities.
-Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews.
-Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls.
-Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting).
-Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management.
-Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance.
-Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients.
-Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives.
-Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews.
-Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks.
-Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management.
-Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations.
-Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned.

Your profile

-Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business.
-Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework.
-Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role.
-6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations.
-Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous.
-Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills.

-Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
-Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst (Transfer Agency)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry.

Your role

• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.

• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.

• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.

• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.

• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.

• Carry out functional acceptance testing, analyze production incidents, and support users during and after implementation.

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by designing and implementing efficient workflows during system changes or migrations, focusing on innovation and optimization over replication of legacy processes

• Actively participate as a member of the Business Analyst Chapter; s hare knowledge, best practices, and drive the evolution of the business analysis discipline within the chapter

Your profile

• Min 5 years experience in a bank as Business Analyst

• Fluent in French and English

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the funds industry, with a strong focus on transfer agency processes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate meetings and workshops.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment

• Project management experience, including organizing and leading cross-functional meetings.

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• In-depth knowledge of transfer agency functions, including investor servicing, transaction processing, and related regulatory requirements.

• Experience with industry platforms and tools relevant to transfer agency (e.g., Multifonds TA, Fenergo); experience with system integrations and data migrations is a plus.

• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting

• Experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on use of JIRA (and Confluence) for story management and project tracking.

• Ability to write clear, structured documentation and user stories.

• Familiarity with AI tools and their application in business analysis; experience implementing AI-driven solutions is a plus.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy & Projects, Risk and Tax departments.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate multiple sensitive and complex cross-functional Risk & Compliance projects at the Group level, steering them from strategic, operational, and organizational standpoints.

You will work in close partnership with Business Lines, Group entities, and the Group Chief Risk Officer to ensure the effective execution and successful delivery of critical initiatives.

Your responsibilities will include driving project governance, fostering collaboration across teams, and ensuring alignment with the Group’s overall objectives.

Your role

• Lead change management projects and programs, including defining roles and responsibilities, establishing project governance, ensuring the quality of deliverables, managing budgets, assessing risks, and designing new processes.
• Coordinate communication with stakeholders, organize training sessions, and ensure a thorough understanding of business needs and requirements.
• Propose and develop innovative solutions, make actionable recommendations, implement changes, and monitor project timelines and milestones.
• Prepare and present regular project updates to senior management and stakeholders.
• Contribute to the development of new solutions and define next steps for ongoing initiatives.
• Proactively challenge existing business practices, suggest improvements or new programs, and take full ownership of deliverables.
• Identify, evaluate, and implement new services and tools to enhance operational efficiency.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in project management, ideally within consulting and/or strategy firms. Experience in the financial or banking industry is a strong asset.
• Interest in data analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, BO), ability to work with AI, machine learning, and automation technologies.
• Proven learning agility and adaptability to thrive in a rapidly evolving technological and financial landscape.
• Highly self-motivated and autonomous, with strong conceptual thinking, an entrepreneurial mindset, and exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of effective collaboration in diverse, cross-functional environments.
• Full professional proficiency in both French and English, written and spoken.
• Must be resident in Switzerland.

As the successful candidate, you should be solutions oriented with excellent communication skills, thorough in your approach to your work and capable of showing initiative. You will also possess excellent analytical and strong technical skills together with proven diplomatic and interpersonal skills. Furthermore, you are able to work autonomously while showing a strong team-spirit.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.
